close_reason: Inlined the three named-capture sites in oscal/emit.rs (Deviation title risk_for, risk_for_deviation, and downgrade action label). The unix_to_rfc3339 format!() also collapsed to inline capture. Three of the bead's six listed sites were already inlined by earlier do-beads work. cargo clippy with default lints + -W uninlined-format-args is clean. 307 tests pass.
description: pkix-lint/src/oscal/emit.rs has six format! calls with positional arguments where inline capture would read more clearly and matches the rest of the codebase: line 391 `format!("Deviation {} applied to {}", df.deviation_id, df.lint_id)`, line 471 `format!("Deviation {} for lint {}", d.id, d.target_lint)`, line 652 `format!("downgrade:{}", severity_label(*s))`, line 745 (uuid_v8) with 16 positional byte args, line 875 (unix_to_rfc3339) with 6 positional time-component args. clippy::uninlined_format_args fires on each. Rationale: inline {x} capture binds the value to the variable at the call site, removing one scan-back when reading. The rest of pkix-lint (e.g. rfc5280.rs:156, deviation.rs:103) uses inline capture; these are the holdouts. Fix is mechanical (rustfmt + clippy --fix). No behavior change.
